subject: Memoize /state + /costflow; guard compaction to primary checkout
description:
Two daemon.js performance/safety items in /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid:

A) MEMOIZE EXPENSIVE READS. GET /state rebuilds the full graph (buildGraph) on every call and GET /costflow recomputes SCC+flow every call; dashboards and heartbeats poll these. Add a short-TTL cache (~3-5s) per workspace, invalidated on every overlay mutation (hook into notifyChange or the save path). CAUTION: buildGraph has side effects (timestamp stamping, unwired quarantine stamp, task autowire for newly-seen tasks) — caching delays those by at most the TTL, which is acceptable, but the cache MUST be invalidated on mutation so claims/status reads never serve stale state. Keep it simple: a {key → {ts, payload}} map, no library.

B) COMPACTION GUARD. compactGraphStores (wired recently near the periodic sweeps at the end of daemon.js startup) must run ONLY in the primary checkout. Worktree checkouts (git worktrees under worktrees/ for attempt branches) also run daemons and also have a tracked .graph — if each compacts independently, merge_attempt later hits delete/modify and checkpoint.json conflicts. Mechanical check: in a git worktree, .git is a FILE (gitdir pointer), in the primary checkout it is a DIRECTORY — skip compaction scheduling when fs.statSync('.git').isFile() (resolve relative to the daemon's repo root, not cwd assumptions; verify how daemon.js locates its own dir). Log one line when skipping.

Tests: add focused coverage for the cache (same payload within TTL, invalidated after a mutation) following existing test conventions; for the guard, a unit test of the predicate function is enough. Verify: node --check daemon.js, run touched tests, then one full `npm run test:all` (NOTE: other agents may be running tests concurrently in this repo — if the full suite flakes with port/EADDRINUSE-style cross-talk, rerun before reporting).

CAUTION: working tree has substantial uncommitted sibling work in daemon.js, lib/, test/, scripts/ — read current state, minimal diffs, never revert. Do NOT restart the live daemon. Do NOT git commit.
